requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Execute assignment of a report to an external maintainer. Ensure the report is in 'Assigned' state and the maintainer ID is valid.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports with status 'Pending Approval'.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId} to move it to 'Assigned' state.
Assign the report to a technical office (simulated prerequisite).
Ensure an external maintainer exists in the system.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the assigned report if it remains in the database after test completion; verify no orphaned assignments exist.
rationale: Validates the core workflow of requirement PT24, ensuring external maintainers can be correctly linked to reports.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Attempt to assign a report to an external maintainer who has not been assigned to the report yet. Verify that the assignment fails or requires prior assignment logic.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report if it remains in the database; verify no partial assignment state exists.
rationale: Tests edge cases where external maintainer assignment logic might fail due to missing prerequisites or invalid states.

requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
prompt: Attempt to update the status of a report that has not been assigned to an external maintainer. Verify that the operation is rejected.
setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report if it remains in the database; verify no unauthorized status updates occurred.
rationale: Tests negative scenarios where an external maintainer attempts to modify a report they are not authorized to manage.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Assign a report to an external maintainer and then verify that the assignment can be retrieved via GET /messages/reports/{reportId} or similar inspection endpoint.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via POST /reports.
Approve the report via PUT /municipal/reports/{reportId}.
Assign the report to an external maintainer via PUT /offices/reports/{reportId}/assign-external.
cleanup_strategy: Delete the report and any associated messages if they remain after test execution; verify no orphaned state exists.
rationale: Tests the stateful dependency where assignment must precede further operations, ensuring correct state transitions.

requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
prompt: Create a new municipality user account with valid credentials and necessary profile data for the 'municipal public relations officer' role.
setup_needed: Ensure authentication session is active as system administrator.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core functionality of user creation for administrative roles.

requirement_summary: System administrator assigns roles to municipality users.
prompt: Assign the 'municipal public relations officer' role to an existing user (created in a previous step or via setup) to enable report review capabilities.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator.
Create a municipality user via POST /admin/users if not already present.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Verifies the role assignment mechanism which is critical for workflow progression.

requirement_summary: Citizen provides details for a report to ensure correct classification.
prompt: Submit a new report with complete details including title, description, category, and location coordinates.
setup_needed: Authenticate as citizen.
Ensure user is logged in as a citizen.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Tests the primary use case of report submission with all required fields.

requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer reviews and approves or rejects reports.
prompt: Update an existing report (created in a previous step) to change its status from 'Pending Approval' to 'Accepted' by the authorized officer.
setup_needed: Authenticate as municipal public relations officer.
Create a report via POST /reports and ensure it is in 'Pending Approval' state.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the approval workflow transition which moves reports to the next stage of processing.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member sees list of reports assigned to them.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /offices/reports/assigned as a technical office staff member. Verify the response contains a list of report objects where the status is 'Assigned' and the assignedTo field matches the current user's role.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid session exists for a technical office staff member (via /auth/login).
Ensure at least one report exists in the system with status 'Assigned' and assigned to this user.
rationale: Validates the core functionality for staff members to view their workload as per PT08.

requirement_summary: Citizen configures their account (notifications and virtual presence).
prompt: Execute a PUT request to /users/me as a citizen. Update the 'emailNotificationsEnabled' field to true and 'virtualPresenceEnabled' to false. Verify the response reflects these changes.
setup_needed: Ensure a valid session exists for a citizen user (via /auth/login).
Ensure the current user has an existing profile to update.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Tests the ability of a citizen to modify their notification and presence preferences as per PT09.
